verdict.rationale: CIPO's own trademarks page lists "Apply for/amend a trademark" and "Renew a trademark" under an Online services block, and its patents page routes filing through "Log in to MyCIPO Patents" alongside guidance on filing and paying maintenance fees. This shows the core filing transaction runs online per the office's published pages. The evidence is limited to navigation-level link labels rather than detailed filing workflows. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the end-to-end online filing and payment flow, explicit confirmation that copyright and industrial design registration and fee payment are completed online, independent or hands-on corroboration.
